We will be using `BPP` to test for gene flow with the multispecies coalescent model with migration between geographically proximate population pairs within the *Anolis distichus* species group on the island of Hispaniola.

# Prepare data

## make popmap files for `Stacks`
```{bash, eval = FALSE}
imaps=$(*Imap.txt)

for f in $imaps; do 

    comp=`basename $f _Imap.txt`

    awk -F_ '{print $2".aligned.sorted"}' $f > samples.txt
    awk '{print $2}' $f > pops.txt

    grep -f samples.txt ../../../sampling-master-detailed.tsv 

    paste samples.txt pops.txt > ../popmaps/${comp}_popmap.tsv

done
```

## run `Stacks`

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=bpp-stacks
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=10
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=12gb
#SBATCH --time=32:00:00
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --error=err.pops_%j
#SBATCH --output=out.pops_%j

source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

CAT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/gstacks/
LIST=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/scripts/bioinformatics/fullmiss90LD_snps.txt
PAIRS=(popmaps/*.tsv)

for COMP in ${PAIRS[@]}; do

    PREFIX=$(basename $COMP _popmap.tsv)
    OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/geneflow/mscm/${PREFIX}

    mkdir -p $OUT_DIR

    # Run populations to get full RAD tags with variant and invariant sites for white-listed loci
    populations -P $CAT_DIR \
        -M $COMP -O $OUT_DIR \
        -W $LIST -t 10 \
        --min-populations 2 \
        --min-samples-per-pop 1.0 \p
        --min-mac 3 \
        --max-obs-het 0.5 \
        --filter-haplotype-wise \
        --fasta-samples

done
```

## Convert fastas to phylip format for `BPP`:

```{python, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
from Bio import SeqIO
from collections import defaultdict

def parse_imap(imap_file):
    """Build dictionary of specimen_number -> BPP_individual_ID"""
    imap = {}
    with open(imap_file) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            fields = line.split()
            bpp_id = fields[0]  # e.g. ignrav_3703_363_ign
            specimen = bpp_id.split("_")[1]  # e.g. 3703
            imap[specimen] = bpp_id
    return imap

def parse_fasta_by_locus(fasta_file):
    """Group sequences by CLocus ID"""
    loci = defaultdict(list)
    for record in SeqIO.parse(fasta_file, "fasta"):
        # Header: CLocus_288_Sample_1_Locus_288_Allele_0 [1388.aligned.sorted; ...]
        header = record.description
        locus_id = record.id.split("_")[1]  # e.g. 288
        sample = header.split("[")[1].split(";")[0].strip()  # e.g. 1388.aligned.sorted
        specimen = sample.replace("_rep.aligned.sorted", "").replace(".aligned.sorted", "")  # e.g. 1388
        allele = record.id.split("_Allele_")[1]  # e.g. 0 or 1
        loci[locus_id].append((specimen, allele, str(record.seq)))
    return loci

def write_bpp(loci, imap, output_file):
    """Write BPP sequence file"""
    with open(output_file, "w") as out:
        for locus_id, seqs in loci.items():
            ntaxa = len(seqs)
            nsites = len(seqs[0][2])
            out.write(f"{ntaxa} {nsites}\n")
            for specimen, allele, seq in seqs:
                if specimen not in imap:
                    print(f"WARNING: specimen {specimen} not in Imap, skipping", file=sys.stderr)
                    continue
                bpp_id = imap[specimen]
                out.write(f"^{bpp_id}_{allele}  {seq}\n")
            out.write("\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 4:
        print("Usage: fasta_to_bpp.py <fasta> <imap> <output>")
        sys.exit(1)
    imap = parse_imap(sys.argv[2])
    loci = parse_fasta_by_locus(sys.argv[1])
    write_bpp(loci, imap, sys.argv[3])
```

# Run `BPP`
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=MSC-M
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=4
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=18gb
#SBATCH --time=7-1:00:00
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --error=err.bpp_%A_%a
#SBATCH --output=out.bpp_%A_%a
#SBATCH --array=1-4

NCHAINS=4

COMP_IDX=$(( (SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID - 1) / NCHAINS + 1 ))
CHAIN=$(( (SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID - 1) % NCHAINS + 1 ))
PAIR=$(sed -n "${COMP_IDX}p" comparisons.txt)
CTRL_BASE="control_files/${PAIR}_ctrl.txt"
OUTDIR="/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/geneflow/mscm/${PAIR}"
CTRL_TMP="${OUTDIR}/${PAIR}_chain${CHAIN}_ctrl.txt"

cp "$CTRL_BASE" "$CTRL_TMP"

sed -i "s|outfile=.*|outfile=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/geneflow/mscm/${PAIR}/${PAIR}_chain${CHAIN}.txt|" "$CTRL_TMP"
sed -i "s|mcmcfile=.*|mcmcfile=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/geneflow/mscm/${PAIR}/${PAIR}_chain${CHAIN}_mcmc.txt|" "$CTRL_TMP"

bpp --cfile "$CTRL_TMP" --no-pin
```

# *A. d. favillarum* - *A. b. wetmorei*
## Assess run convergence
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(coda)

runs <- lapply(list.files(path = "/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/phylo/bpp/favillarum_brevirostris/",
                            pattern = "_mcmc.txt", full.names = TRUE),
                function(x){df <- read_table(x, col_names = TRUE)
                            df <- df[, !colnames(df) %in% "Gen"]  ### Remove generations column
                            df <- mcmc(df)
                }
        )
chain_data <- mcmc.list(runs)
```

```{r}
summary(chain_data)
### estimate sample size adjusted for autocorrelation
effectiveSize(chain_data)
### estimate potential scale reduction factor (PSRF) for each parameter
### When upper limit is close to 1, convergence has been reached
gelman.diag(chain_data)
gelman.plot(chain_data)

# png("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/favillarum_brevirostris_traceplots.png", width = 8, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
# par(mfrow = c(4, 2))
traceplot(chain_data)
# dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(KernSmooth)

# Function to compute Savage-Dickey BF
savage_dickey_bf <- function(posterior_samples, prior_shape, prior_rate, epsilon = 0.01) {
    
    # Prior density at epsilon: M ~ G(shape, rate)
    prior_at_eps <- dgamma(epsilon, shape = prior_shape, rate = prior_rate)
    
    # If all posterior samples exceed epsilon, BF -> Inf
    if (all(posterior_samples > epsilon)) {
        return(Inf)
    }
    
    # Otherwise estimate posterior density at epsilon using KDE
    kde <- bkde(posterior_samples)
    post_at_eps <- approx(kde$x, kde$y, xout = epsilon)$y
    
    # BF10 = prior density / posterior density at epsilon
    BF10 <- prior_at_eps / post_at_eps
    
    return(BF10)
}

# Load and combine chains for a given comparison
# (after trimming to common number of samples and confirming convergence)
combined_favbrev <- do.call(rbind, lapply(runs, as.data.frame))
hpd <- HPDinterval(as.mcmc(combined_favbrev), prob = 0.95)
hpd

summary(combined_favbrev$`M_adf->ab`)
summary(combined_favbrev$`M_ab->adf`)

# Compute BF for each migration direction
# migprior = 0.1 10 means G(shape=0.1, rate=10)
adf_ab <- savage_dickey_bf(combined_favbrev$`M_adf->ab`, 
                                   prior_shape = 0.1, 
                                   prior_rate = 10)

ab_adf <- savage_dickey_bf(combined_favbrev$`M_ab->adf`, 
                                   prior_shape = 0.1, 
                                   prior_rate = 10)

cat("BF10 (favillarum -> brevirostris):", adf_ab, "\n")
cat("BF10 (brevirostris -> favillarum):", ab_adf, "\n")
cat("favillarum -> brevirostris supported:", adf_ab > 20, "\n")
cat("brevirostris -> favillarum supported:", ab_adf > 20, "\n")
```


While convergence was not reached, we have what appears to be label switching, with two chains achieving stationarity in one region of the posterior and the other two chains achieving stationarity in another region of the posterior in each direction. 
Chains 1 and 3 suggest migration is higher in the ignigularis -> properus direction (*M* ~ 0.8) and lower in the properus -> ignigularis (*M* ~ 0.2) direction, while chains 2 and 4 suggest the opposite.

# Visualize migration rates as heatmap

```{r, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9, echo = FALSE, evaluate = FALSE}
library(ggnewscale)
library(viridis)

comps <- list(combined_favbrev, combined_ravbrev, combined_brevign,
        combined_ignrav, combined_domtib, combined_ravdom, combined_wetdes,
        combined_domign)

### fix this to accommodate direction-less aggregated comparisons
comp_simple <- imap_dfr(comps, function(x, name){
        x %>%
            dplyr::select(starts_with("M_")) %>%
            pivot_longer(
            everything(),
            names_to = "direction",
            values_to = "migration_rate"
            ) %>%
            mutate(direction = str_remove(direction, "^M_")) %>%
            separate(direction, into = c("from", "to"), sep = "->") %>%
            mutate(run = name)
    }
)

### Given taxon names more informative names for visualization
comp_simple$from[comp_simple$from == "adr" ] <- "rav"
comp_simple$to[comp_simple$to == "adr" ] <- "rav"
comp_simple <- comp_simple %>%
    # filter(!(from == "adf" & to == "ab")) %>%
    mutate(
    from = case_when(
        run == 1 & from == "ab" ~ "wet",
        run %in% c(2, 3) & from == "ab" ~ "des",
        run %in% c(5, 6) & from == "dom" ~ "w_dom",
        run == 8 & from == "dom" ~ "e_dom",
        run == 8 & from == "ign" ~ "e_ign",
        run %in% c(3, 4) & from == "ign" ~ "w_ign",
        TRUE ~ from),
    to = case_when(
        run == 1 & to == "ab" ~ "wet",
        run %in% c(2, 3) & to == "ab" ~ "des",
        run %in% c(5, 6)& to == "dom" ~ "w_dom",
        run == 8 & to == "dom" ~ "e_dom",
        run == 8 & to == "ign" ~ "e_ign",
        run %in% c(3, 4) & to == "ign" ~ "w_ign",
        TRUE ~ to)
        )

taxon_lookup <- c(
    "adf" = "A. d. favillarum",
    "wet" = "A. b. wetmorei",
    "des"  = "A. b. deserticola",
    "rav" = "A. d. ravitergum",
    "w_ign" = "A. d. ignigularis (west)",
    "e_ign" = "A. d. ignigularis (east)",
    "w_dom" = "A. d. dominicensis (west)",
    "e_dom" = "A. d. dominicensis (east)",
    "tib" = "Tiburon A. distichus subspecies",
    "prop" = "A. d. properus"
)

comp_simple <- comp_simple %>%
  mutate(
    from = recode(from, !!!taxon_lookup),
    to   = recode(to,   !!!taxon_lookup)
  )

mean_rates <- comp_simple %>% group_by(from, to) %>%
    summarise(mean_M = mean(migration_rate), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(status = "tested")

### Drop directions found to have BF10 < 20
### favillarum -> brevirostris
taxon_order <- sort(unique(c(mean_rates$from, mean_rates$to)))
mean_rates <- mean_rates %>%
    complete(from = taxon_order, to = taxon_order,
             fill = list(status = "not_tested")) %>%
    mutate(
        from = factor(from, levels = taxon_order),
        to   = factor(to,   levels = taxon_order),
        status = if_else(from == "A. d. favillarum" & to == "A. b. wetmorei",
                          "non_significant", status),
        status = if_else(as.character(from) == as.character(to), "diagonal", status),
        mean_M = if_else(status %in% c("non_significant", "diagonal"), NA_real_, mean_M)
    )

ggplot() +
    # background layer: non-significant / not-tested / diagonal, categorical fill
    geom_tile(
        data = mean_rates %>% filter(status != "tested"),
        aes(x = to, y = from, fill = status),
        color = "grey50",      # visible grid lines between all tiles
        linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
        "not_tested"       = "white",
        "non_significant"  = "black",
        "diagonal"         = "gray70"
        ),
        name = NULL,
        guide = "none"
    ) +
    new_scale_fill() +
    # foreground layer: actual measured, significant rates, continuous fill
    geom_tile(
        data = mean_rates %>% filter(status == "tested"),
        aes(x = to, y = from, fill = mean_M),
        color = "grey50",      # same border treatment for consistency
        linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Migration rate (M)") +
    # print the estimate in white text on top of significant (colored) tiles
    geom_text(
        data = mean_rates %>% filter(status == "tested"),
        aes(x = to, y = from, label = round(mean_M, 3)),
        color = "white",
        size = 3
    ) +
    labs(x = "Recipient", y = "Donor") +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic")
    )
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}
knitr::include_graphics("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/figures/mean-migration-rates.pdf")
```

# Visualize migration rate distiributions for each comparison

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 4}
### need to add prop_ign, ign_EW, and dom_EW comparisons
comps <- c(comps, list(prop_ign, dom_EW, ign_EW))
names(comps) <- c("favbrev", "ravbrev", "brevign", "ignrav", "domtib", "ravdom", "wetdes", "domign" , "propign", "domEW", "ignEW")

m_summary <- imap_dfr(comps, function(x, run_name) {
    x %>%
        dplyr::select(starts_with("M_")) %>%
        pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "direction", values_to = "migration_rate") %>%
        mutate(direction = str_remove(direction, "^M_")) %>%
        group_by(direction) %>%
        summarise(
        mean_M   = mean(migration_rate),
        median_M = median(migration_rate),
        lower95  = quantile(migration_rate, 0.025),
        upper95  = quantile(migration_rate, 0.975),
        .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(run = run_name)
})

direction_order <- c("ab->adf", "ab->adr", "adr->ab", "ab->ign", "ign->ab", ### distichus -- brevirostris comparisons
        "wet->des", "des->wet", ### just brevirostris
        "dom->rav", "rav->dom", "rav->ign", "ign->rav", "dom->tib", "tib->dom", ### all distichus
        "domEW_low", "domEW_high", "ign->dom", "dom->ign",    
        "ignEW_low", "ignEW_high", "ignprop_low", "ignprop_high")

plt_data <- m_summary %>%
    filter(direction %in% direction_order) %>%
    mutate(direction = factor(direction, levels = direction_order))

brev_dist <- c("ab->adf", "ab->adr", "adr->ab", "ab->ign", "ign->ab")
distichus <- c("dom->rav", "rav->dom", "rav->ign", "ign->rav", "dom->tib", "tib->dom",
        "domEW_low", "domEW_high", "ign->dom", "dom->ign",    
        "ignEW_low", "ignEW_high", "ignprop_low", "ignprop_high") 
brev <- c("wet->des", "des->wet")

abad <- which(levels(plt_data$direction) %in% brev_dist)
ab <- which(levels(plt_data$direction) %in% brev)
ad <- which(levels(plt_data$direction) %in% distichus)

ggplot(plt_data, aes(x = direction, y = median_M)) +
    annotate("rect",
             xmin = abad - 0.5, xmax = abad + 0.5,
             ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#E8782A", alpha = 0.25) +
    annotate("rect",
             xmin = ab - 0.5, xmax = ab + 0.5,
             ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#E8DC2A", alpha = 0.15) +
    annotate("rect",
             xmin = ad - 0.5, xmax = ad + 0.5,
             ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#729C1C", alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lower95, ymax = upper95)) +
    labs(x = "Migration pair", y = "Migration rate (M)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
# ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/figures/fig-components/migration-rate-ranges.pdf", width = 12, height = 4)
```

# Plot migration rates against F~ST and π

## Fst as dependent variable
```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
### Read in population-level Fst estimates
load("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/snp-analyses/Fsts/full_miss90LD_clade_Fst.RData")

fst_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(distichus_clade_Fsts$Fsts))
fst_df <- fst_df[!is.na(fst_df$Freq), ]
colnames(fst_df) <- c("pop1", "pop2", "Fst")

### drop irrelevant taxa for migration rate comparisons
fst_df <- fst_df %>%
      filter(!(pop1 %in% c("websteri", "caudalis", "marron", "biminiensis",
                "dapsilis", "distichus", "distichoides", "ocior", "sejunctus") |
            pop2 %in% c("websteri", "caudalis", "marron", "biminiensis",
                "dapsilis", "distichus", "distichoides", "ocior", "sejunctus"))) %>%
        droplevels() %>%
        bind_rows(rename(., pop1 = pop2, pop2 = pop1))


run_lookup <- as_tibble(data.frame(
                        run = c("favbrev", "ravbrev", "brevign", "ignrav", "domtib", "ravdom",
                                "wetdes", "domign", "propign", "domEW", "ignEW"),
                        pop1 = c("favillarum", "ravitergum", "deserticola", "west_ignigularis",
                                "west_dominicensis", "ravitergum", "wetmorei", "dom2",
                                "properus", "dom2", "east_ignigularis"),
                        pop2 = c("wetmorei", "deserticola", "west_ignigularis", "ravitergum",
                                "tiburon", "west_dominicensis", "deserticola", "east_ignigularis",
                                "east_ignigularis", "west_dominicensis", "west_ignigularis")
))

m_plt <- m_summary %>%
            filter(!(direction %in% c("adf->ab")))%>%
            left_join(run_lookup, by = "run") %>%
            left_join(fst_df, by = c("pop1", "pop2")) %>%
            mutate(comp = ifelse(run %in% c("favbrev", "ravbrev", "brevign"),
                    "between complex", "within complex"))


mig_fst_bt <- lm(formula = mean_M ~ Fst,
                data = m_plt[m_plt$comp == "between complex",])      
mig_fst_bt
summary(mig_fst_bt)

mig_fst_w <- lm(formula = mean_M ~ Fst,
                data = m_plt[m_plt$comp == "within complex",])
mig_fst_w
summary(mig_fst_w)

ggplot(m_plt, aes(x = mean_M, y = Fst, shape = comp, color = comp)) + #, fill = direction)) + 
        geom_point(size = 4) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
        # ### Between
        # geom_abline(slope = coefficients(mig_fst_bt)[2],
        #             intercept = coefficients(mig_fst_bt)[1],
        #             color = "#E8782A") + 
        # ### Within
        # geom_abline(slope = coefficients(mig_fst_w)[2],
        #             intercept = coefficients(mig_fst_w)[1],
        #             color = "#729C1C") +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("between complex" = "#E8782A",
                            "within complex" = "#729C1C")) +
        scale_shape_manual(values = c("between complex" = 17,
                            "within complex" = 16)) +
        xlab("Migration rate (M)") + ylab(expression(F[ST])) +
        annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.65,
                label = "R^2 == 0.0003 ~ ',' ~ italic(p) == 0.980",
                hjust = 0, size = 5, parse = TRUE) +
        annotate("text", x = 0.4, y = 0.15,
                label = "R^2 == 0.2668 ~ ',' ~ italic(p) == 0.0405",
                hjust = 0, size = 5, parse = TRUE) +
        # guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + 
        theme_bw() +
        theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            legend.title = element_blank())
# ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/migration-Fst.pdf", dpi = 300)
```
